## Why visit

The strongest reason here to continue beyond Macclesfield into Bollington. A stone-built local with a fire, transport memorabilia and a conversational atmosphere, it combines traditional cask with a substantial cider and perry selection. The local CAMRA branch named it Pub of the Year in 2026 after cider recognition in 2025, making the detour well aligned with both halves of your brief. Go to spend time with the range and the room, not to collect a hurried half between buses. A daylight walk can add context when weather and the return plan allow.

## Beer

CAMRA reports six cask beers, including regular bitters and two rotating guests; Draught Bass is a particular documented attraction.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Explicit CAMRA cider/perry offer and 2025 branch cider award; tasting flights are reported. Confirm current makers and measures.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

No full kitchen established; local pies on selected Friday/Saturday service and snacks are documented.

## Plan the visit

Cash is preferred according to CAMRA. Check the last return bus; do not assume the nearby closed Vale Inn is a backup.

**Getting there:** Buses from Macclesfield serve the stop beside the pub; verify the November timetable.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
